source: Coherent companion TSMC40 standard-Vt; no original ST beta or ST Vth.
normalization: Equal-geometry independent-pair sigma normalized by population mean; per-device sqrt(2) conversion. Pair-average ratios additionally checked.
geometry_transfer: Source drawn W/L area law; APM public drawn W/L. L interpolation in log L. W=1–4um,L=.12–.40um are model-transfer hypotheses, not a measured APM rectangle.
uncertainty: Source 95% intervals and PDF digitization bounds in pinned dataset; between-process and L-interpolation errors unquantified, not sampled per device.
